rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely: reuses cookieFilterAction, same module ID scheme, same Caddyfile subdirectives, interface guards added, registered beside cookie filter.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through, delete drops whole value, quoting preserved, attributes kept verbatim via Cut on ';', exact name match; no handling of non-array input but that matches the field shape.
rationale.scope: Focused on the feature; only stray change is adding a caddy.Validator guard for the existing CookieFilter, which is unrelated though harmless.
rationale.readability: Clear doc comments, small helper replaceSetCookieValue with a precise comment, labelled continue matches existing CookieFilter style.
rationale.robustness: No panics: ParseSetCookie errors handled, defensive !found check, non-array input returned unchanged, no shared mutable state.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's rather than a shared helper; otherwise small, self-contained and easy to extend.
